name: 85379 · Surprise, AZ
findings: ZIP 85379 (Surprise) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85379 (Surprise) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85379 (Surprise) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
